change: The Null Space Workshop: what a matrix crushes

mutations.name: Av uses a column for a row
the determinant adds
the row multiple reads off the wrong entries
zero counts as crushed
the steep matrix is not singular
the full-rank matrix is singular
the flat matrix crushes nothing in reach
a negative entry loses its brackets
a crushed arrow reads as not crushed
rank and nullity miscount
mutations.find: so the nullity is 0: rank 2 + nullity 0 = 2 columns
mutations.replace: so the nullity is 1: rank 2 + nullity 1 = 2 columns

mutations.name: the line goal takes one arrow
the reach goal takes any point
Av is drawn to v's scale
the gold line is drawn on every matrix
the null-space line is drawn along a row
Av is drawn upside down
a new matrix keeps the old arrow
crushed arrows are never remembered
mutations.find:
pick(i){ this.si=i; this.x=1; this.y=1; this.touched=true; this.look(); this.render(); },
  step(w,by){ const v=this[w]+by; if(v<this.LO || v>this.HI) return; this[w]=v; this.touched=true; this.look(); this.render(); },
mutations.replace:
pick(i){ this.si=i; this.x=1; this.y=1; this.touched=true; this.render(); },
  step(w,by){ const v=this[w]+by; if(v<this.LO || v>this.HI) return; this[w]=v; this.touched=true; this.render(); },

mutations.name: the caption forgets the gold line
mutations.find: ${this.det()===0?' The gold dashed line is everywhere Av can land.':''}

mutations.name: a found goal gives no toast
mutations.find:
'MASTER OF THE NULL SPACE','every crushed line found','var(--gold)',()=>Sfx.mastered());
      else { UI.toast('✓ '+fresh.map(g=>g.toast).join(' · ')); Sfx.good(); }
mutations.replace:
'MASTER OF THE NULL SPACE','every crushed line found','var(--gold)',()=>Sfx.mastered());
      else { Sfx.good(); }

mutations.name: the stepper runs past its end
the matrix buttons lose their names
the drawing loses its name
the Tome card is missing
rank-nullity points nowhere
